tagline: Say it. Plan it. Get it done.
brief: An AI personal assistant that transforms conversational intentions into structured, actionable plans with real backend state execution. Calm, capable, honest, and warm.
criteria: Success: distinct from generic chatbot clichés, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, conveys honest action and arrival.

concepts.name: The Arch & Arrival
concepts.idea: A pure geometric arch spanning from intention to completion, anchored by an arrival milestone.
rationale: A bridge from intention to action with zero clutter or ornament
Tested to hold up clearly from 16 px favicon to high-res displays
Built on a strict geometric grid with round caps and optical balance
Pairs a cool neutral scale with a single action accent: Harbor

recommendation: The Arch & Arrival — an enduring, quiet, and timeless mark that communicates arrival at done with honest simplicity.
next_steps: Integration into production web application and PWA assets
Implementation across documentation, pitch deck, and developer hackathon video
Final asset deployment across light and dark system themes
